== Card credits ==
Darren Malins is credited on [[Players Committee]] [[Virtual cards]] with the original concept of six cards.<ref name="labels">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/resources/card_labels.json card_labels.json] in billbisco/swccg-gemp (commit 0bc4377d9): the printed labels of every Players Committee Virtual card, transcribed from the PC's card images. Field definitions: [https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/docs/card_labels.md docs/card_labels.md].</ref> The credited cards were printed in [[Virtual Set 7]] (2017), [[Virtual Set 8]] (2017), [[Virtual Set 13]] (2020), [[Virtual Set 19]] (2022) and [[Virtual Set 27]] (2026), so the credited cards span 2017–2026. The full list of people credited on Virtual cards is at [[Card Credits#Darren Malins|Card Credits]].
